title: Comic Strips
text:
Tom loves comic strips. Every morning he reads them in the newspaper before breakfast. His favorite comic has a funny dog named Max. Max always gets into trouble, and Tom laughs every time.

Last year, Tom started drawing his own comic strips. He draws four small pictures on a piece of paper. His friends say his drawings are very funny. Tom wants to be a comic artist one day.

questions.text: What is the name of the funny dog in Tom's favorite comic?
How many pictures does Tom draw in his own comic strip?
Why does Tom read comic strips every morning?
options: He likes them and finds them fun
He has to write them for school
He wants to sell the newspaper
He does not have any books

questions.text: What can we guess about Tom's future?
options: He will probably work with comics
He will move to another country

vocabulary.definition: a funny story told in pictures
printed paper with news, often read every day
a person who creates drawings or paintings

paragraph_translations: Том любить комікси. Щоранку він читає їх у газеті перед сніданком. Його улюблений комікс має смішного собаку на ім'я Макс. Макс завжди потрапляє в неприємності, і Том сміється кожного разу.
Минулого року Том почав малювати власні комікси. Він малює чотири маленькі картинки на аркуші паперу. Його друзі кажуть, що його малюнки дуже смішні. Том хоче колись стати художником коміксів.
